case: TOTAL over mixed STRICT ANY values and typed CSV re-import
contract: SQLite total() returns REAL for integer, REAL, numeric-text, nonnumeric-text/BLOB, mixed and all-NULL groups; all-NULL input produces 0.0.
A no-row aggregate also returns 0.0 with native typeof() equal to real.
An integer pair above the signed 64-bit sum boundary returns a floating result instead of SUM's integer-overflow refusal.
The computed result column retains fallback metadata; typed CSV re-import restores every exact f64 result as native REAL, verified by typeof().
